item.dc:creator: AlanMoore
item.content:encoded: From the Github: This is a native PC port of P.T., the 2014 PS4 teaser by Kojima Productions. It is not an emulator. The game logic wasrebuilt in C++ from the original's behaviour and the renderer is written on Vulkan; every level, model, texture, sound,script and cutscene is read at run time from your own copy of the PS4 game.
